majors_note: A race is a Major when it is a Platinum marathon whose name contains one of these.

profile_rule._about: Who is in focus for a season (scripts/update_focus.py): the top N finishers per event by kind of race (for championships, only the listed distances), and the top N of each season list with a mark better than the N-th mark of the same list in the previous season. Profiles are kept up to date for the previous season's final list and everyone on the current season's list.
